meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用语法树精准搜索和改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多语言项目中按代码结构而非文本进行搜索和替换
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by syntax tree precisely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search and replace code by structure across multiple languages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会改用 ast-grep 按代码结构查找和改写代码(能认出函数、调用、类等形状),而不是按文本搜索;它会先显示预览,再按你的确认修改文件。
howto.when: 当你要求按代码形态查找/改写时触发,例如:找出某类函数或调用、批量替换 console.log、去掉 as any 等;纯文本/注释内容用 rg/grep。

say.text: 把项目里所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
say.note: 先预览,确认后才真正改写文件。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按函数结构匹配,列出文件和行号。

say.text: 扫描当前目录的 YAML 规则并报告违规
say.note: 运行 scan,输出违规位置和数量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use ast-grep to search and rewrite code by its structure (functions, calls, classes, etc.) rather than by text; it previews changes and only modifies files after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for structural code matching/rewriting, e.g. finding functions/calls of a given shape, rewriting console.log calls, stripping as any, etc.; plain text/comments go to rg/grep.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in the project
say_en.note: Shows a preview first; writes only after confirmation.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter
say_en.note: Matches by function shape and lists files and lines.

say_en.text: Run the YAML rules in the current directory and report violations
say_en.note: Runs scan and reports locations and counts.
